about_the_game:
Wander the forgotten halls of a deserted schoolhouse, nothing could possibly go wrong, right?

ABOUT


As you find yourself trapped in a webby hallucination, you must explore and try to escape an abandoned education facility whilst avoiding unwanted and aggressive hosts.
You'll need a strong mind and quick wits, as this school has more problems than simple mathematics...

FEATURES


  • A story driven game but with fun minigames and puzzles.
  • Challenging puzzles that make you think.
  • Explore interesting and unsettling environments
  • Hide or fight away the mannequins and other things that may be after you!
  • Unlock the minigame-locked hard drives to find out on whats happening!

short_description: Set in a desolate forest in rural Shreveport Louisiana, a 16 year old teenager and experienced abandoned building explorer "Riley" finds himself exploring a school with a darker history than meets the eye
